cases.sentence: «Воспойте ___ новую песню, так как Он сотворил чудеса.»
cases.translation: Sing to the Lord a new song, for he has done marvelous things!
cases.explain: The verb воспойте (sing) with a dative object governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Его правая рука, Его святая рука принесла Ему ___.
cases.translation: His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.
cases.explain: Победу is the direct object of the transitive verb принесла (brought), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Господь явил своё ___, свою праведность показал народам.
cases.translation: The Lord has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.
cases.explain: Спасение is the direct object of the transitive verb явил (has made known), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Он вспомнил милость и верность свою к дому ___.
cases.translation: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel.
cases.explain: The genitive marks the possession of the house belonging to Israel.

cases.sentence: Прославляйте ___ на арфах, на арфах со звуками песнопений!
cases.translation: Sing praises to the Lord with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
cases.explain: Господа is the direct object of the transitive verb прославляйте (praise), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Под звуки труб и рогов радостно восклицайте перед ___ Господом!
cases.translation: With trumpets and sound of the ram's horn, make a joyful noise before the King, Lord!
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Пусть рукоплещут ___, пусть веселятся вместе горы перед Господом.
cases.translation: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.
cases.explain: Реки is the subject of the verb пусть рукоплещут (let clap), taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: потому что Он идет судить ___, Он будет судить вселенную справедливо.
cases.translation: for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness.
cases.explain: Землю is the direct object of the transitive verb судить (to judge), taking the accusative case.

reading.ru: «Воспойте Господу новую песню, так как Он сотворил чудеса.»
reading.question: Why does the psalmist call people to sing a new song to the Lord?
options: Because he has done marvelous things
Because the old songs are too long
reading.correct: Because he has done marvelous things
reading.explain: The text gives the reason: 'так как Он сотворил чудеса' — because he has done marvelous things.

reading.ru: Его правая рука, Его святая рука принесла Ему победу.
reading.question: What has the Lord's right hand and holy arm brought to him?
reading.explain: The text states 'принесла Ему победу' — has brought him victory.

reading.ru: Восклицай, Господу, вся земля! Восклицайте громко, веселитесь и пойте!
reading.question: What emotions and actions does the psalmist call forth from the earth?
options: Shouting, loud rejoicing, merriment, and singing
reading.correct: Shouting, loud rejoicing, merriment, and singing
reading.explain: The commands are 'Восклицай' (shout), 'Восклицайте громко' (shout loudly), 'веселитесь' (rejoice), and 'пойте' (sing).

reading.ru: Пусть шумит море и все, что наполняет его, вселенная и живущие в ней!
reading.question: What creation is called to make noise and what is included in it?
options: The sea and all that fills it, the universe and those who dwell in it
Only the birds in the sky
Only the fish in the water
reading.correct: The sea and all that fills it, the universe and those who dwell in it
reading.explain: The text lists 'море и все, что наполняет его, вселенная и живущие в ней' — sea and all that fills it, the universe and those living in it.

reading.ru: Пусть рукоплещут реки, пусть веселятся вместе горы перед Господом.
reading.question: What personified actions do rivers and mountains perform before the Lord?
options: Rivers clap their hands and mountains sing for joy together
Rivers flow and mountains stand still
Rivers dry up and mountains crumble
Rivers become silent and mountains weep
reading.correct: Rivers clap their hands and mountains sing for joy together
reading.explain: рукоплещут реки (rivers clap) and веселятся вместе горы (mountains rejoice together) are the personified actions.

reading.ru: потому что Он идет судить землю, Он будет судить вселенную справедливо и народы верно.
reading.question: For what purpose does the Lord come, and how will he judge?
options: To judge the earth, the universe with righteousness, and the peoples with his truth
reading.correct: To judge the earth, the universe with righteousness, and the peoples with his truth
reading.explain: The text says He comes 'судить землю' and will judge 'справедливо' (with righteousness) and народы 'верно' (with truth).
